name: dotfiles-cli
description: CLI for managing dotfiles - syncing, checking differences, and initializing on new devices

scripts.format: oxfmt --write cli/src cli/tests package.json tsconfig.json tsconfig.build.json .oxlintrc.json .oxfmtrc.json
scripts.format:check: oxfmt --check cli/src cli/tests package.json tsconfig.json tsconfig.build.json .oxlintrc.json .oxfmtrc.json
scripts.sync: git pull && bun run build && ./dot sync
